summary: Grupo Televisa filed a 6-K disclosing that a consortium, owned 50/50 by Televisa and Fintech Holdings Inc., agreed to acquire AT&T's Mexican wireless business, AT&T Mexico, for US$2 billion subject to adjustments. AT&T Mexico is Mexico's second-largest mobile operator with about 24.7 million wireless subscribers as of December 31, 2025, and reported 2025 revenue of 85.4 billion pesos. The consortium expects to fund the deal with cash on hand and non-recourse secured debt, accounting for the stake as an equity-method joint venture. Closing, targeted for Q1 2027, awaits customary conditions and regulatory approvals; a Spanish-language Folleto Informativo was published via BMV and CNBV. Watch antitrust/IFT clearance timing and financing terms.
